english.title: Sponsor fail to maintain applicant rules - immigration
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) during a period namely **(..SPECIFY..) to **(..SPECIFY..), in respect of which you had given a written undertaking in pursuance of the immigration rules to be responsible for the maintenance and accommodation of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), persistently refused or neglected without reasonable excuse to maintain that person in accordance with the said undertaking and, in consequence, support under Part VI of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999 was provided for or in respect of that person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 108(1) and (2) of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.

english.notes:
(i) See Section 95 for details for the provision of support for asylum-seekers or the dependants of asylum-seekers.
(ii) A person is not to be taken to have refused or neglected to maintain another person by reason only of anything done or omitted in furtherance of a trade dispute.
